⚠️ Important notice: if you put any symbol immediately after markup, it will not work: *here is the comma*, without space.

You should leave space before and after , to make it work.

Same for _underscore_, and -hyphen-.

Leave space before opening and after closing underscore and hyphen. Put all dots and commas inside markup.
